Category and search-result templates were not retained because they share MediaWiki chrome and timed out under parallel evidence capture; the primary anonymous reading journey and search/recovery affordances remain represented.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared light and emulated-dark screenshots and computed color-scheme.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation remains visually light and computed color-scheme is normal.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and queried document.getAnimations().
checkOutcomes.evidence: The preference matched and zero active animations were present.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected loaded CSS and Lighthouse contrast/accessibility audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Loaded CSS includes forced-colors handling and Lighthouse color-contrast passed; essential UI remains visible in screenshots.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected all loaded CSS for view-transition support and reviewed MPA link navigation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition rules are present for cross-document article navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected CSS and page behavior for scroll-linked decorative motion.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked motion exists to implement. No JS scroll animation anti-pattern was observed.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates do not use scroll-linked animation.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed narrow/desktop screenshots and CSS feature probe for gesture overrides.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reading uses native scrolling and links; no custom pointer handlers, hijacked scrolling, or gestures that fight platform behavior were observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured long article extent and inspected CSS for scroll state/timeline cues.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The article main region is 86,786px tall and no progress or scroll-state CSS was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected complete loaded stylesheet feature usage for menus/tooltips.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Menus are present but no CSS anchor positioning declarations are loaded.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed homepage/article navigation hierarchy, skip link focus, tabs, headings, TOC and missing-page recovery.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Current location tabs, article headings/table of contents, language control, and a visible focused skip link provide orientation and attention cues.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured first-load screenshots on homepage, article/login and missing-page states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No pop-up, consent wall, ad, or interstitial obscures primary content on load.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected DOM and Lighthouse accessibility tree for overlay/menu controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile main navigation uses a checkbox with role=button rather than a button plus disclosure/popover primitive.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually reviewed first viewport and content proportions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The anonymous homepage and article prioritize encyclopedia content; chrome is compact and there are no ads.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured at 360x800 and read layout/viewport metrics.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The desktop response declares width=1120 and is scaled down instead of reflowed.

checkOutcomes.method: Searched 827,657 characters of loaded CSS for @container and compared desktop/mobile captures.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container query rules are present for reused card/navigation components.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused a control and ran Lighthouse target-size audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focus is visible, but several article links have target dimensions/separation below 24px.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed homepage/article/login first viewports and headings.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The encyclopedia purpose, article title, search/navigation, and login action are explicit and visually prominent.

checkOutcomes.method: Walked the anonymous reading path from homepage to representative article and inspected login as a secondary flow.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core content is available without an account and article links are real crawlable hrefs; login has a concise labelled form.

checkOutcomes.method: Opened a nonexistent article and inspected its recovery controls.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The missing-page state clearly says the article does not exist and offers search, similarly titled pages, help, and creation paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse mobile on the France article and a CDP trace on the homepage.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Article LCP was 6.6s and FCP 4.7s; homepage LCP was 2.42s.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts with layout primitive and Lighthouse CLS.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage observed CLS was 0.00043 and article Lighthouse CLS was 0.

checkOutcomes.method: Read trace and Lighthouse total-blocking-time signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage trace had no long tasks/TBT; article Lighthouse TBT was 83ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and inspected compact network summary and Lighthouse dependency insights.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Script bytes dominate and early parser-inserted resources plus a 328KB script delay the content path.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse unused-code audits and compared with HAR type totals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 91KiB unused JS and 45KiB unused CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility audits and inspected rendered image/form attributes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The article has unnamed images/links and a mis-exposed menu checkbox.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse a11y audits and reviewed article link styling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Inline links fail the non-color distinction requirement against surrounding text.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected heading/landmark DOM and programmatically focused the first interactive element.
checkOutcomes.evidence: One H1, hierarchical section headings, main/nav landmarks, a skip link, and a 2px solid visible focus outline were observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually reviewed desktop article/home and login typography and Lighthouse zoomed mobile rendering.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body text has comfortable line-height and content width on the purpose-built mobile article skin; no clipping was reported by Lighthouse.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse viewport/target/media audits and narrow screenshot review.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport permits scaling and article reflows for mobile UA, but multiple touch targets are too small.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse runtime console-error audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected doctype/charset, image primitive and Lighthouse asset audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/charset are valid and aspect ratios pass, but the homepage has one image missing dimensions and oversized assets.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse deprecation, BFCache, inspector and source-map audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Deprecated API and BFCache audits pass, but Lighthouse reports missing/broken source maps for large first-party scripts and a cookie issue in DevTools.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed title/meta description and ran Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Titles are descriptive, but meta description is absent on homepage and representative article.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected hrefs, viewport, robots.txt and Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: All 659 homepage anchors have hrefs, Lighthouse crawlable-anchors/robots passed, and the mobile article has a viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected canonical, status, robots sitemap declaration and Lighthouse canonical/hreflang audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Pages return 200, homepage has a canonical URL, Lighthouse canonical and hreflang pass, and robots.txt declares the REST sitemap.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected Open Graph/structured metadata and visible semantic article structure.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage exposes Open Graph tags; MediaWiki articles use semantic headings, image metadata and canonical links consistent with visible content, with no misleading schema found.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran headers, cookies, mixed-content/Lighthouse and secrets primitives.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff and no secrets are good, but CSP allows unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval and a session-labelled cookie is not Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and tracker enumeration.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No known tracker domains were found; third-party requests are limited to Wikimedia-operated upload/auth origins and no sensitive secret was exposed.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected login UI/autocomplete and initial-load behavior.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt appears on load; login uses username webauthn plus current-password autocomplete, indicating passkey-capable conditional authentication.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran security-header primitive.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS/nosniff pass, but frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran raw-HTML discoverability comparison and crawler screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 98% of rendered content words are present in raw HTML; title and H1 survive without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed native navigation, missing-page recovery and Lighthouse runtime audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No uncaught errors or BFCache blocker was detected; navigation and recovery work as documents/links without fragile shell state.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked for a manifest/service worker link and considered site type.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No manifest is linked on desktop; anonymous Wikipedia is a public reference content site, not an installed app journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: Installability/offline app-shell behavior is not necessary for this public reference website; progressive enhancement remains separately tested.

checkOutcomes.method: Loaded a nonexistent article route and reviewed recovery actions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The missing route produces a clear, content-rich recovery state with search/help/navigation rather than a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Probed document language/direction and reviewed 347-language navigation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document declares lang=fr and dir=ltr and exposes 347 language variants; the UI uses localized French labels.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed localized dates/numbers/content and MediaWiki language output in representative pages.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Dates, number grouping and interface strings are rendered in French locale conventions across homepage/article UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed representative encyclopedia and account surfaces for user-scheduled times/events.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No booking, scheduling, recurring event, or time-zone-sensitive primary flow exists on the audited templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited content/reference templates do not perform user-facing time-zone arithmetic.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed homepage, login and recovery screenshots for deceptive design.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No ads, confirmshaming, forced continuity, consent nagging or disguised actions were present; donation/account actions are plainly labelled.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted blank login submission and reviewed missing-page recovery.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Blank login preserves the simple labelled form without blame, and missing content gives specific recovery links and search.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected login form labels and autocomplete tokens.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Username uses autocomplete="username webauthn" and password uses current-password; both have visible labels.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed anonymous/account entry points and login flow.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No commercial commitment exists; sign-in is optional for reading, session persistence is an unchecked explicit choice, and help/recovery links are visible.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image primitive and HAR transfer analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 15 below-fold images lack lazy loading; 16 use legacy formats; three are oversized.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and Lighthouse unused-code signals.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The anonymous reading path downloads large optional bundles and measurable unused code.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR, tracker and screenshot evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No autoplay audio/video or advertising tracker is present; Wikimedia image/auth origins account for 205,869 third-party bytes and directly support page content/account state.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw and rendered content and inspected semantic/crawlable links.
checkOutcomes.evidence: 98% raw-HTML content coverage, semantic headings and real hrefs make encyclopedia content reliably machine-readable; MediaWiki also exposes canonical structured endpoints even though no WebMCP tool is declared.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected page globals/markup and considered the core encyclopedia reading task.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No on-device inference feature is offered or required for the audited reading/login paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: Built-in summarization or language-model inference is an optional emerging enhancement, not necessary for Wikipedia’s core content delivery.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline heap with a post snapshot after ten real scroll down/up cycles.
checkOutcomes.evidence: JS object count changed 9,582→9,595 and closures 7,942→7,944; growth was concentrated in native objects loaded by scrolling, not accumulating JS state.

checkOutcomes.method: Read heap-summary totals and constructor populations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline self size was 19.46MB with 241,701 nodes, proportionate to the content-rich homepage; common JS constructors remained modest.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared heap constructor summaries before/after repeated scrolling.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appears among retained constructors; Object and closure populations were effectively stable after ten cycles.

paths.description: Entry/home template: purpose, discovery, visual hierarchy, preferences, responsive behavior, network, privacy and baseline memory.
Representative long encyclopedic article and primary anonymous reading journey.
Representative authentication/form flow, labels, autocomplete, optional session continuity and invalid submission.
Missing article/network-like recovery state with search and alternative actions.

findings.summary: The anonymous desktop experience does not follow the system dark-color preference.
findings.evidence: The prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot is visually identical to the light screenshot and computed color-scheme is normal, despite dark-mode CSS being shipped.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the automatic appearance option the anonymous default, declare color-scheme: light dark, and apply the existing dark tokens from prefers-color-scheme without requiring a saved account preference.

findings.evidence: The loaded CSS probe found no view-transition rules, while Wikipedia is an MPA whose primary interaction is following article links.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin article navigation with @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Very long articles provide no scroll-position progress cue.
findings.evidence: The France article DOM reports 86,786px of main content, while the loaded CSS contains no scroll-timeline support and the observed chrome has no reading-progress indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an unobtrusive CSS scroll-driven reading-progress indicator to long article templates and hide/reduce it for reduced motion.

findings.summary: Menus and transient controls do not use CSS anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The homepage includes menu/search overlays, but the full loaded stylesheet probe found no anchor-name or anchor-positioning use.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning with position-try fallbacks for transient menus/tooltips where browser support permits, retaining the current fallback.

findings.summary: The mobile navigation trigger is a checkbox presented as a button instead of a semantic disclosure/popover control.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies #main-menu-input as input[type=checkbox][role=button] with aria-haspopup, and reports an inappropriate accessibility-tree pattern and hidden label.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the checkbox-button pattern with a real button controlling a popover or dialog/navigation disclosure, with declarative dismissal and synchronized expanded state.

findings.summary: The desktop skin fixes its layout viewport at 1120px and scales down at a 360px viewport.
findings.evidence: At --viewport 360x800, layout reports clientWidth/scrollWidth 1120 and meta viewport width=1120; the screenshot renders the whole desktop page as tiny text rather than reflowing.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width and make Vector responsive with intrinsic sizing and fluid breakpoints; do not rely only on user-agent skin selection.

findings.summary: Reusable components rely on page/viewport rules rather than container queries.
findings.evidence: The full 827,657-character loaded stylesheet probe found no @container rules, while the homepage reuses card, nav, and content modules at different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable content regions and use size/content container queries for card and navigation variants.

findings.summary: Some article links have touch targets below the recommended minimum.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size audit identifies multiple 12-20px-high links with safe clickable diameters below 24px, although keyboard focus on the skip link is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase line-height/padding or spacing around dense table, citation, and media links so each has at least a 24px target or equivalent separation.

findings.summary: The representative article loads too slowly under Lighthouse mobile conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 4.7s, LCP 6.6s, Speed Index 6.0s and performance 0.63; LCP is well outside the good threshold. The homepage trace was better at 2.42s, showing template/device variance.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the article LCP text/render path, reduce startup work and blocking CSS, and defer nonessential modules until after content paint.

findings.summary: Large startup bundles and blocking styles delay primary content.
findings.evidence: Homepage HAR transferred 918,580 bytes, including 547,401 script bytes; the largest script was 328,093 bytes and two parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets plus startup script were early candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Split ResourceLoader modules by immediate need, defer optional editing/telemetry/UI modules, and keep the critical style set minimal for anonymous reading.

findings.summary: The article ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports estimated savings of 91KiB unused JavaScript and 45KiB unused CSS; the HAR separately shows script as the dominant transfer type.
findings.suggestedFix: Use route/feature conditional ResourceLoader bundles and delay editing, analytics, popups, and other optional modules until invoked.

findings.summary: The article template contains unnamed links/images and an incorrectly exposed menu toggle.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility 0.81 reports two images without alt, three links without discernible names, and the main-menu checkbox with a hidden label/inappropriate role.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images alt text or explicit presentational semantics, name media/magnify links, and replace the checkbox menu trigger with a correctly named button.

findings.summary: Inline links are distinguished from surrounding prose by color alone with insufficient non-text contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse link-in-text-block audit reports blue links at 1.32:1 or 2.35:1 against surrounding text and no underline on multiple article links.
findings.suggestedFix: Underline links in article prose by default or provide another persistent non-color cue, while preserving sufficient text contrast.

findings.summary: Public pages omit a meta description.
findings.evidence: The homepage metadata probe returned description:null, and Lighthouse failed the meta-description audit on /wiki/France despite valid titles.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate concise, page-specific meta descriptions from the lead summary, with editorial overrides where available.

findings.summary: A session-labelled cookie lacks Secure and the CSP permits unsafe script execution modes.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found frwikimwuser-sessionId without Secure or HttpOnly; headers show CSP script-src allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval. HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark session identifiers Secure and HttpOnly where script access is unnecessary, set an explicit SameSite policy, and migrate scripts away from unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval using nonces or hashes.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers audit found no X-Frame-Options and no CSP frame-ancestors directive, plus no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; HSTS and nosniff are correctly present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP frame-ancestors (preferred over X-Frame-Options), a restrictive Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The homepage leaves many below-fold and legacy-format images unoptimized.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 15 below-fold images without loading=lazy, 16 legacy-format images, three oversized assets and one missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold images, retain responsive srcset, supply dimensions, and serve modern formats where the source asset permits.

taskList.title: Restore accessible names, roles and link distinction
Make Vector genuinely responsive at narrow viewports
Reduce article LCP and anonymous-reader bundles
Harden cookies, CSP and browser policies
Progressively enhance navigation and reading orientation
